name: validate_archive

test_list.description: Generated ZIP inputs exercise valid archives, entry count, total expansion, duplicate normalized names, traversal, ratio, and malformed input.
Generated duplicate-normalized names, traversal names, expansion, count, and malformed archives are rejected.
An archive member whose expansion ratio is greater than one but less than two is rejected at a ratio cap of one.
Invalid ZIP bytes return a parser error without panicking.

inputs.name: limits
inputs.description: Entry count, total expansion, per-entry expansion, and ratio bounds.

output_description: Archive accepted for downstream parser or rejected before extraction.
